risks_b: Visible tests do not cover empty filename, nil content, or verify that validation occurs before any request.
Visible tests do not cover a reader that fails during multipart encoding, although the implementation directly returns NewFile's error.

The retry test counts attempts but does not read and compare multipart payloads across attempts, so it weakly verifies replayed-body fidelity and does not demonstrate a one-shot/streamed source reader specifically.
